Class Simulation

java.lang.Object
simEngine.Simulation
public class Simulation extends Object
This class creates a new Simulation. It provides an easy way to initialize the jmt engine.
Author:
Federico Granata, Stefano Omini, Bertoli Marco Modified by Ashanka (May 2010): Patch: Multi-Sink Perf. Index Description: Added new Performance index for capturing 1. global response time (ResponseTime per Sink) 2. global throughput (Throughput per Sink) each sink per class.

    • addMeasure

      public void addMeasure(int measureType, String nodeName, Measure measure, String jClass, String nodeType) throws LoadException
      Adds to the system a new measure to be computed.
      Parameters:
      measureType - type of measure (see the constants specified in this class).
      nodeName - name of the node to be measured. [Attribute assign in `referenceNode`]
      "" (empty string) means Global Measure, no need specify referNode.
      measure -
      jClass - name of the job class to be measured. [Attribute assign in `referenceUserClass`]
      null means measuring all the class, not to the specific class
      nodeType - type of the node to be measured. [Attribute assign in `nodeType`]
      - null -> Global Measure, no specific referNode.
      - station -> Node Measure, bind to a specific referNode
      - region -> Capacity Region Measure.
      Throws:
      LoadException
